families.name: Dupont
families.note: Square single-row housings, often ganged. Mates with standard pin headers.

families.name: JST XH
families.note: The usual balance-lead and 3D printer connector. Friction fit, ribs on top.

families.name: JST PH
families.note: Small LiPo cells, Grove (as HY 2.0) and many dev boards.

families.name: JST ZH
families.note: Compact wire-to-board. Central ramp on top of the housing.

families.name: JST SH
families.note: Qwiic and STEMMA QT use the 4-pin SH. Friction bumps at each end.

families.name: JST GH
families.note: Positive latch on top. Pixhawk and drone peripherals.

families.name: JST VH
families.note: Larger pitch for power: heaters, mains-side boards, appliances.

families.name: Molex KK 254
families.note: Friction ramp lock on one side. PC fans, older PC internals.

families.name: Molex PicoBlade
families.note: Thin housing with a lip along the top. Cameras, small modules.

families.name: Molex Micro-Fit 3.0
families.note: Dual row, keyed square and D cavities. GPU and board power.

families.name: Molex Mini-Fit Jr
families.note: Larger dual-row power: ATX, EPS, PCIe cables.

families.name: IDC box header
families.note: Shrouded dual row with a key slot. Ribbon cables, JTAG, SWD.

families.name: JST SM
families.note: Wire-to-wire with a latch arm. LED strips.

families.name: XT30
families.note: Small Amass power plug. Chamfered side shows polarity.

families.name: XT60
families.note: Standard battery plug for drones, RC and e-bikes.

families.name: XT90
families.note: Large Amass plug. The S version adds an anti-spark resistor.

families.name: T-plug
families.note: Two flat blades at right angles, forming a T.

families.name: JST RCY
families.note: Red 2-pin plug for small batteries and BECs. Latch ramp on top.

families.name: Anderson Powerpole
families.note: Genderless, dovetailed housings. Ham radio and 12 V gear.

families.name: DC barrel
families.note: Coaxial power. Outer sleeve, insulator, centre pin hole.

families.name: Screw terminal
families.note: Clamp screws on top, square wire entries below.

families.name: USB-C
families.note: Reversible. Stadium shell with a centre tongue.

families.name: Micro-USB
families.note: Trapezoid shell, tongue along the wide side.

families.name: USB-A
families.note: Rectangular shell, tongue on one half.

families.name: SMA
families.note: Threaded coax for antennas and test gear. Hex body, PTFE insulator.

families.name: U.FL
families.note: Tiny snap-on coax for Wi-Fi and GPS modules. Board side, top view.

families.name: BNC
families.note: Bayonet coax. Two lugs lock with a quarter turn. Scopes and video.

families.name: RJ45 / RJ11
families.note: Modular jack. Latch notch at the bottom. RJ11 is the 6-wide version.

families.name: D-sub
families.note: Trapezoid shell. Serial ports, CAN, joysticks. Male face shown.

families.name: HDMI
families.note: Wide shell with chamfered lower corners, tongue in the middle.

families.name: FFC / FPC
families.note: Flat flex cable end with exposed contacts. Displays and cameras.

families.name: 3.5 mm jack
families.note: Audio plug: tip, ring and sleeve split by insulating bands.

families.name: MR30
families.note: Three-pin Amass plug for brushless motors.

families.name: EC3 / EC5
families.note: E-flite bullet plugs. One round and one square housing.

families.name: M8 / M12
families.note: Sensor connector. Knurled nut, keyed insert, pins on a circle.

families.name: GX16 aviation
families.note: Threaded round connector. Key tab on the shell, pins on a circle.

families.name: Banana
families.note: Sprung lantern pin for bench supplies and meters.

families.name: Wago lever nut
families.note: Lever splice connector. One lever and one entry per wire.

families.name: JST EH
families.note: Like XH but with a closed lock tab on top.

families.name: Ring terminal
families.note: Closed eye. Cannot fall off the stud.

families.name: Fork terminal
families.note: Open slot. Slides under a loosened screw.

families.name: Spade (female)
families.note: Quick-disconnect receptacle with rolled edges. Fits Faston blades.

families.name: Blade (Faston)
families.note: Male tab with a detent hole. Also 2.8 and 4.8 mm.

families.name: Butt connector
families.note: Joins two wires end to end. Heat-shrink versions seal.

families.name: Ferrule
families.note: Wire-end sleeve for screw and push-in terminals.

variants.name: Pin header
variants.note: Straight male pins through a plastic spacer.

variants.name: Right-angle header
variants.note: Pins leave the board sideways. Spacer on the mating side.

variants.name: SMD header
variants.note: Surface-mount feet, alternating left and right.

variants.name: Socket header
variants.note: Female strip. Open bores along the top.

variants.name: Shrouded header
variants.note: Board-side half of JST, Molex and IDC: pins inside a walled shroud.

variants.name: Cable housing
variants.note: Crimp housing on the wire end. Sockets open at the face.

variants.name: Cable plug
variants.note: Wire-to-wire male half. Pins stand proud of the face.

variants.name: Crimp socket
variants.note: Loose female contact: box receptacle, wire and insulation crimps.

variants.name: Crimp pin
variants.note: Loose male contact: solid pin, wire and insulation crimps.

variants.name: Board jack
variants.note: Board-mount receptacle: USB, barrel, XT. Opening faces the edge.

variants.name: Panel mount
variants.note: Bulkhead jack. Flange in front of the panel, nut behind.
